papers.title_en: Adaptive Retrieval, Selective Answers: Evaluating Conformal Factuality in Agentic RAG
papers.evidence: 评估智能体式RAG系统的保形事实性
papers.tldr: 针对agentic RAG中自适应检索与终止后生成难以保证逐条声明有据的问题，本文沿用检索相关性评分与生成后conformal过滤，在六组模型-数据集配置上评估claim级conformal factuality。结果显示提高目标支持率会提升全支持率但压缩答案可用性；95%目标下非空响应覆盖17.23%–60.17%，声明保留10.72%–43.16%，非空输出全支持89.14%–95.56%。作者显式刻画自适应检索轨迹，揭示终止后校准的可靠性与信息量权衡。
papers.abstract_en: Retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) can improve factual grounding without guaranteeing that every generated claim is supported. Previous work has studied claim-level conformal factuality in single-stage RAG and, more recently, multi-hop RAG. We examine its behavior in agentic RAG, where a language-model policy adaptively issues follow-up retrieval queries or terminates retrieval before response generation. We retain the retrieval-based relevance-scoring formulation and post-generation conformal filtering and evaluate six model-dataset configurations: GPT-6 Luna and Llama 3.1 8B on HotpotQA, Natural Questions, and TriviaQA. Each configuration uses 60 fixed questions, 100 seeded 30/30 calibration-test partitions, five conformal target levels, and a no-conformal-prediction baseline. Across the six configurations, higher target levels are accompanied by higher observed full-support rates and reduced answer availability. At the 95% target, non-empty response coverage ranges from 17.23% to 60.17%, claim retention from 10.72% to 43.16%, and full support among non-empty outputs from 89.14% to 95.56%. We formulate the adaptive retrieval trajectory explicitly and characterize the reliability-informativeness trade-off when conformal factuality is applied after agent termination.

papers.title_en: OA-RAG: Ontology-based Agentic RAG for Faithful LLM Reasoning
papers.authors: Hui Yang, Jiaoyan Chen, Yongsheng Gao
papers.evidence: 结合本体证据的RAG以缓解幻觉
papers.tldr: 针对LLM在生物医学等知识密集型领域易产生幻觉、现有RAG忽视逻辑关系且过度依赖模型自身推理的问题，提出OA-RAG。该智能体融合本体逻辑结构与非正式注释，将形式推理与LLM推理结合，并为每个答案标注本体证据及接地等级。在三大本体和六个医学问答基准上总体最优，推理密集任务提升明显，接地等级可指示答案可靠性，并证明本体可作为有竞争力的知识源。
papers.abstract_en: Large language models (LLMs) perform well across many real-world tasks but remain prone to hallucination, limiting their reliability in domains such as biomedicine and healthcare, where answers must be grounded in established knowledge. Retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) mitigates this problem by incorporating external information, but often overlooks logical relationships and relies heavily on the LLM's own reasoning, which can compromise answer faithfulness. We propose OA-RAG, an agent that integrates formal reasoning with LLM reasoning, drawing on both the logical structure and informal annotations of domain ontologies. For each answer, OA-RAG reports the ontology observations used as evidence and a model-assessed grounding level (entailed, supported, related, or unrelated) that characterises the strength of that evidence. Across benchmarks derived from three large-scale ontologies and six real-world medical question-answering tasks, OA-RAG achieves the best overall performance among the evaluated ontology-fine-tuned and popular RAG methods, with particularly strong results on reasoning-intensive tasks. The reported grounding levels also offer a useful indication of answer reliability, with stronger grounding generally associated with higher accuracy. Finally, our results demonstrate the value of ontologies as knowledge sources: OA-RAG is competitive with, and sometimes outperforms, domain-specific RAG systems that draw on sources such as textbooks.

papers.title_en: DeFT-RAG: Incrementally Decomposing Multi-Hop Questions into Self-Contained Sub-Questions with Reusable Answers
papers.evidence: 将多跳问题分解为带可复用答案子问题的RAG
papers.tldr: RAG在多跳问答上难以串联跨文档证据链，图式方法检索不全、迭代方法让LLM负担过重。DeFT-RAG逐次生成自包含子问题，并用规则维护QA表、轻量决策模型做判断，同时缓存复用同义子问题答案。在MuSiQue、2WikiMultiHopQA和HotpotQA上，它以gpt-4o-mini和Qwen3.6为骨干均取得十三种基线中最佳准确率，且输入token最少。跨1000题共享缓存命中23.1%子问题，减少12.9% LLM调用而不降准确率。
papers.abstract_en: Retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) lets a large language model (LLM) answer questions by retrieving relevant passages from a large corpus. However, RAG struggles with multi-hop questions, which require chaining facts spread across several documents through intermediate entities that the question never mentions. Graph-based RAG methods retrieve once from the entities a question names and so rarely recover the full evidence chain. Iterative RAG methods recover it step by step, but their accuracy is limited by the many tasks they ask the LLM to perform, such as planning the sub-questions, deciding their dependencies, rewriting them as answers arrive, and keeping track of what is known. We propose DeFT-RAG, a RAG framework built on three components. First, DeFT-RAG generates one self-contained sub-question at a time from the original question and the sub-questions answered so far with their answers (QA pairs). Each sub-question names every entity it asks about, which removes the need to plan, track dependencies or rewrite, and lets the LLM focus on a single fine-grained task at a time. Second, DeFT-RAG moves the remaining LLM work outside the LLM: rule-based updates to a QA table that keeps track of what is known, and yes/no decisions made by a fine-tuned lightweight decision model. Third, DeFT-RAG caches the QA pairs and reuses an answer when a later question asks a sub-question with the same meaning. On MuSiQue, 2WikiMultiHopQA and HotpotQA, DeFT-RAG achieves the best accuracy among thirteen baselines with both gpt-4o-mini and Qwen3.6 as the backbone, while giving the LLM fewer input tokens than any other iterative method. With a QA cache shared across 1,000 MuSiQue questions, 23.1% of sub-questions are answered from the cache, which reduces LLM calls by 12.9% without lowering accuracy.

papers.title_en: Glance: The Generator Is Its Own Reranker
papers.evidence: 单一生成模型通过共享预填充同时完成RAG段落重排与回答
papers.tldr: 检索增强生成通常将重排器与生成器分开部署，导致模型常驻和段落处理重复。Glance 在生成器上加入轻量决策适配器与指针头，从一次共享 prefill 的缓存上下文中分支出相关性探针，为每个候选段落打分而无需逐对预填充。仅用 39 分钟 MS MARCO 微调，便在 SciFact/NFCorpus 上取得 0.741/0.345 nDCG@10，并在 HotpotQA 上使答案 F1 较交叉编码器选择提升 0.045。该工作展示单一 9B 常驻骨干同时完成生成与重排的潜力。
papers.abstract_en: Retrieval-augmented generation commonly serves separate models for reranking and answering, duplicating model residency and passage processing. We introduce Glance, which equips the generator with a lightweight decision adapter and pointer head to score candidate passages from a shared prefill. Short relevance probes branch from the cached context, producing one score per passage without separately prefilling each query-passage pair. A single resident 9B backbone supports generation, general decisions and reranking, with approximately 0.1 GiB of additional memory per decision skill. After 39 minutes of MS MARCO fine-tuning, Glance achieves nDCG@10 of 0.741 on SciFact and 0.345 on NFCorpus, compared with 0.721 and 0.326 for bge-reranker-v2-m3. On 300 HotpotQA questions, its selected context improves answer F1 by 0.045 over cross-encoder-selected context under the same base generator (paired bootstrap 95% CI [0.014, 0.076]). In a scaling study, reranking quality keeps rising up to 200 candidates (43k tokens) scored from one shared prefill, where it exceeds the cross-encoder by 0.058 nDCG@10, and a probe-only activated adapter lets generation continue from the original passage cache. These initial results demonstrate generator-based reranking with one resident backbone; evaluation currently covers two retrieval datasets, one QA dataset and one backbone family.

papers.title_en: An Interactive GraphRAG Workspace for Reifying, Auditing, and Steering Conversational AI Memories
papers.authors: Munshi Md Arafat Hussain, Md. Abdur Rahman, Md Saeed Siddik
papers.evidence: 用于固化与调控对话式AI记忆的交互工作台
papers.tldr: 多会话软件开发中，对话LLM的技术知识被困在线性聊天史，跨会话复用面临多跳检索失效、API时序漂移污染与提示膨胀。CognitiveCanvas将对话记忆转为可操作、可审计的知识对象，集成HSFG、时序漂移审计器与空间符号提示编译器。HSFG把对话蒸馏为Goal/Fact/Code并减少92.2% token，支持多跳GraphRAG；审计器结合60+正则与日历锚定LLM验证实现一键纠错。该工作使对话AI记忆可具体化、审计与引导，为跨会话上下文管理提供交互式GraphRAG工作区。
papers.abstract_en: Conversational Large Language Models (LLMs) are widely employed in software engineering for code generation, debugging, and architectural design. However, as developers engage in multi-session development tasks, technical knowledge becomes siloed in isolated, linear chat histories. Reusing context across sessions leads to three critical challenges: (1) flat-vector retrieval fails to traverse multi-hop relational dependencies between distant architectural decisions; (2) temporal drift in software packages and APIs results in silent context poisoning when reusing aged dialogue logs; and (3) raw conversation concatenation induces prompt bloat and attention degradation.   We present CognitiveCanvas, an interactive tool that transforms conversational AI memories from ephemeral text logs into persistent, manipulable, and audited knowledge objects. \textsc{CognitiveCanvas} integrates: (1) a Hierarchical Semantic Fact-Graph (HSFG) that distills dialogues into Goal, Fact, and Code artifacts, achieving a 92.2\% token reduction while enabling multi-hop GraphRAG traversal; (2) a Continuous Temporal Drift Auditor coupling 60+ regex heuristics with live calendar-anchored LLM verification for 1-click self-correction; and (3) a Spatial-Symbolic Prompt Compiler (SSPC) that translates 2D direct manipulation gestures (Voronoi clustering, node resizing, synthesis edges) directly into structured attention directives

papers.title_en: Navigating Epistemic Parity in LLM Agents: A Benchmark for Cross-Source Conflict Resolution Between Memory and Procedural Skills
papers.evidence: 面向智能体情景记忆与技能模块冲突的基准
papers.tldr: LLM Agent常并行注入情景记忆与程序性技能，二者无优先级且可发出矛盾指令，形成“认知对等”。论文构建跨源冲突基准，含四类矛盾、52个场景与三种上下文条件，以确定性检查器评估。1383次运行显示裁决取决于冲突类型、模型和注入顺序，显式优先级指令仅部分有效。89%运行未披露矛盾，工具调用时98.8%无文本，沉默裁决成为默认。
papers.abstract_en: Production LLM agents increasingly run episodic memory pipelines and procedural skill modules (e.g., SKILL.md files) in tandem. Both are injected into the same context region with no defined precedence, so they can issue contradictory instructions that no instruction hierarchy resolves, a condition we term epistemic parity. We introduce a benchmark for measuring how LLM agents adjudicate such cross-source conflicts. We (i) develop a four-way taxonomy of memory-skill contradictions (factual, format, procedural, permission); (ii) instantiate 52 scenarios under a tripartite test-case anatomy (memory injection, skill injection, ambiguous user task), scored almost entirely by deterministic checkers over tool-call payloads and output structure; and (iii) run each scenario under three context conditions to isolate positional bias, measure the efficacy of an explicit precedence directive, and classify disclosure behavior, quantifying silent adjudication: resolving a conflict without telling the user. Across 1,383 runs on three open-weight models, neither source wins uniformly: resolution depends jointly on conflict type, model, and injection order. Moving the skill block nearer the task raises its win rate in all six factual and procedural cells (sign test, p = 0.031) but reverses for format conflicts, indicating that adjudication tracks token placement rather than source semantics. An explicit "skill takes absolute precedence" directive raises skill compliance on the two stronger models yet leaves 3-10% residual non-compliance, and moves the smallest model's factual and procedural resolution in the wrong direction. Most consequentially, in 98.8% of runs where the agent acted through a tool call it emitted no accompanying text at all, and 89% of all runs disclosed nothing about the contradiction: silent adjudication is the default. Code, scenarios, and raw outputs are public.

papers.title_en: Towards a Learnable Retriever for Textual Graph Question Answering
papers.authors: Kaifeng Jin, Yuchen Yan, Zhichen Zeng, Xiao Lin, Lihui Liu, Yinglong Xia, Hanghang Tong
papers.evidence: 可学习LLM检索器将语言模型锚定在结构化图知识上
papers.tldr: 文本图问答和GraphRAG需用结构化证据支撑LLM，但现有方法缺少端到端可学习的图证据检索器，且检索监督少用金答案信号，易导致覆盖不足或噪声过多。作者提出TaLenT，将可学习LLM检索器与微调LLM生成器统一到检索-生成流程，并用金答案信号分层监督节点选择。三个GraphQA数据集上，TaLenT稳定提升下游性能。该工作为文本图问答提供了兼顾覆盖与紧凑性的端到端检索方案。
papers.abstract_en: Textual graph question answering (GraphQA) and graph-based retrieval-augmented generation (GraphRAG) have gained increasing attention as a way to ground large language models (LLMs) on structured knowledge. Despite extensive efforts, existing methods still face two key gaps. The first is an architectural gap: existing methods typically fine-tune an LLM-based generator, but do not also make the retriever itself a learnable LLM for graph evidence selection within one end-to-end retrieve-then-generate pipeline. The second is a retrieval-supervision gap: existing retrievers rarely use gold answer signals to supervise evidence selection. As a result, they may fail to recall evidence nodes required for reasoning, resulting in insufficient coverage of the gold answer set; meanwhile, naive attempts to boost recall often introduce excessive irrelevant information that compromises compactness and overwhelms the LLM. To address these gaps, we propose TaLenT, an LLM-based end-to-end retriever-generator framework for textual GraphQA. To bridge the architectural gap, TaLenT pairs a learnable LLM-based retriever for evidence selection with a fine-tuned LLM-based generator within one unified retrieve-then-generate pipeline. To bridge the retrieval-supervision gap, we leverage gold answer signals as retriever supervision. Specifically, we stratify graph nodes into gold answers, answer-related nodes, and irrelevant noise. We then adopt a weighted pseudo-label loss to prioritize gold answers and preserve answer-related nodes for coverage, while discarding irrelevant noise for compactness. Experimental results across three GraphQA datasets demonstrate that TaLenT consistently improves downstream performance.

papers.title_en: GLOBE: Evolving Structured Agentic Memory for E-commerce Product Optimization in Generative Search
papers.authors: Hyunseo Kim, Suil Choe, Sukkyoung So, Daeyeon Yi
papers.evidence: 存储可复用优化行为的演化式结构化智能体记忆
papers.tldr: 生成式搜索的商品优化要求智能体跨类目持续积累改写策略，但现有方法把结构化列表当自由文本，策略难以复用。GLOBE将优化知识组织为显式、按字段划分的行为手册，由编辑应用行为、反思模块依据排名反馈更新，并辅以审核去重和管理提交。实验显示结构化行为优于整体提示优化，反馈演化与审核提升效果并降低风险。学习行为可迁移到未见类目，表明该记忆演化支持可解释、可迁移的商品优化。
papers.abstract_en: Optimizing product listings for generative search requires language agents not only to rewrite effectively but also to continually self-improve by retaining successful strategies across diverse categories. However, existing approaches often treat structured listings as free-form text, leaving effective strategies implicit in prompts, search trajectories, or rewritten outputs rather than accumulating them as a reusable agentic memory. To address this limitation, we introduce GLOBE, an agentic framework that drives continual self-improvement by storing optimization knowledge in an evolving handbook of explicit, field-scoped behaviors. In each episode, an Editor applies relevant behaviors and receives rank-based feedback, which a Reflector converts into behavior updates. Crucially for dependable execution in real-world settings, a Moderator removes redundant proposals, a Curator commits accepted changes, and consistently harmful behaviors are deactivated. This cycle transforms episodic feedback into a persistent, field-scoped optimization memory. Experiments show that structured behaviors outperform monolithic prompt optimization, while feedback-driven evolution and moderation further improve effectiveness and reduce downside risk. The learned behaviors also remain effective on unseen product categories, suggesting that agentic memory evolution supports interpretable and transferable product optimization.

papers.title_en: Can Agents Keep Secrets They Were Never Told? Benchmarking Latent Privacy Risks Across Sessions with MemJoin
papers.authors: Qishun Yang, Shu Yang, Difei Xu, Di Wang, Meng Ding
papers.evidence: 评测长期记忆系统跨会话存储与组合用户信息的风险
papers.tldr: 智能体跨会话长期记忆会拼接用户信息，可能在普通任务中泄露未被告知的敏感关系。MemJoin 构建288个合成分析案例，使单会话信息不足而完整历史可推出敏感关系，并评测六种记忆系统与全历史/无历史对照。结果显示仅检查属性值是否出现不足以判断跨会话组合泄露，去掉共享标识等线索可改变完整关系输出。
papers.abstract_en: To support sustained interactions and personalized assistance, agents use long-term memory to retain and combine user information across sessions. Reusing such memories can lead an agent to state a sensitive relation while completing an ordinary task that does not require it. The relation to protect and the combination of clues that reveal it may remain hidden at memory write time, when later records and tasks are still unknown. In this paper, we introduce MemJoin, a privacy benchmark of 288 synthetic analysis cases in which the complete history entails a sensitive relation, but every individual session is insufficient. We evaluate six memory systems with the same answer-generating model, alongside full-history and no-history controls. Each system writes and updates memories in session order and later retrieves context for an ordinary task, while target annotations remain with the evaluator. We separately check which target attribute values appear in stored records and retrieved context, and whether the final answer states the complete, person-linked relation. In a separate paired test on a prespecified subset, removing shared identifiers and other connecting clues can change complete-relation output while all checked target attribute values remain visible. These findings show why checking attribute visibility alone is insufficient to evaluate what records from different sessions reveal together.

papers.title_en: Write Once, Query Many: Evolving Compact Reusable Memory for Long Videos
papers.authors: Kerui Chen, Jinglu Wang, Yun Wang, Xinjiang Wang, Yan Lu
papers.evidence: 一次写入可复用可演化的视频记忆与读写模块
papers.tldr: 长视频常超出多模态大模型上下文，逐查询检索又重复处理视频。Video-EMem以时间锚定的文本加稀疏图像构建可复用记忆，Writer一次编码多尺度观测，Reader仅从记忆检索证据，并用不同反馈演化工作流。相比原始视频存储降约99.86%，在三个长视频QA基准上较直接输入2048帧平均提升2.6%。它为长视频提供紧凑、可演化且可复用的记忆方案。
papers.abstract_en: Long videos often exceed the context capacity of multimodal large language models (MLLMs), while agentic search repeats costly video processing and grounding for each query. Reusable memory can amortize this cost, but must preserve information for questions unknown during construction. We propose Video-EMem, an evolvable video memory harness built on time-anchored perceptual observations. This representation combines compact free-form text with sparse images to preserve semantic content and complementary visual details across temporal scales, supporting temporal navigation without a fixed semantic schema. A Writer encodes each video once by consolidating overlapping multiscale observations, and a Reader retrieves and organizes evidence solely from the resulting memory. With the underlying models frozen, we evolve their workflows and operators using distinct feedback: query-independent source fidelity and coverage for the Writer, and QA failures in evidence localization and utilization for the Reader. Experiments support this separation for generalization beyond development queries, with our evolution strategy improving average accuracy by 7.2% over the unevolved harness. While reducing storage by about 99.86% on average relative to raw videos, Video-EMem improves Qwen3-VL-30B by an average of 2.6% across three long-video QA benchmarks over direct input of 2,048 frames. Using the same o3 answer model as the state-of-the-art agentic method, it improves average accuracy by 2.5% with lower per-query latency.

papers.title_en: MemBubble: Benchmarking How Agent Memory Shapes LLM Response Diversity
papers.authors: Jiajun Tan, Fei Sun, Xinyu Ma, Shixuan Zhang, Du Su, Qi Cao, Daiting Shi, Huawei Shen, Xueqi Cheng
papers.evidence: 基于真实用户-助手对话构建的智能体记忆系统基准
papers.tldr: LLM智能体的记忆能提升个性化，但可能压缩回复多样性，现有评测多依赖合成交互且覆盖系统有限。作者构建MemBubble基准，含1000个源自真实用户-助手对话偏好的实例，并用跨场景但主题相关的查询衡量记忆对回复分布的集中效应。在多种LLM与记忆机制上，熵平均下降34.7%，显著高于直接提供完整交互历史；简单用户干预和信息可得性调整未能弥合差距。该工作揭示记忆处理导致的多样性损失，呼吁在个性化之外兼顾信息多样性与用户可及性。
papers.abstract_en: Memory serves as the core component of LLM-based agents, enabling personalized responses via extracting and using user preferences from past interactions. However, its use may reduce response diversity, thereby narrowing the range of information available to users. Existing evaluations rely largely on synthetic interactions and cover few memory systems, leaving the effects of memory on response diversity insufficiently evaluated in real-world scenarios. We introduce MemBubble, a benchmark of 1000 instances built on preferences extracted from real user-assistant conversations. To measure the extent to which memory concentrates response distributions, we construct test queries in scenarios distinct from user preferences while preserving topical relevance through shared preference categories. Across multiple LLMs and memory mechanisms, entropy decreases by 34.7% on average compared with directly providing the full interaction history, highlighting the important role of memory processing in diversity loss. We also explore simple user-side interventions and changes in information availability but find that these do not effectively close the diversity gap. Our findings highlight the need to consider preserving diversity and user access to information alongside improvements in personalization when designing and using agent memory systems.

papers.title_en: 4DMemory: Benchmarking Long-Horizon Spatiotemporal Memory with Harness-Augmented Agents
papers.authors: Yanhao Jia, Yi Zhu, Yiran Zhong, Weigao Sun, Feida Zhu, Pengkun Jiao, Sihan Yang, Ming Ma, Steven Hoi, Erik Cambria
papers.evidence: 面向增强型智能体评测长程持久时空记忆
papers.tldr: 现有基准多聚焦短中期上下文，基础模型难以在长时程中保留细粒度时空信息。论文构建约900小时LongVideo数据集与4DMemoryBench，覆盖视觉、文本和时空推理，并提出整合四类技能、22+工具模型及RAG的4DMemory Harness。评测13个领先模型显示，独立基础模型长时程表现受限，而Harness使全部模型提升超50%，且相较旧基准性能下降逾10%。该工作为长时程时空智能体评测与增强提供基准和框架。
papers.abstract_en: Humans efficiently process multimodal streams spanning hours to years, building persistent, fine-grained spatiotemporal memories that support reasoning about and predicting long-horizon events. In contrast, existing benchmarks focus on short- and medium-context tasks, and most foundation models struggle to preserve fine-grained information over long horizons. To evaluate and improve long-horizon spatiotemporal reasoning, we introduce the LongVideo dataset and the 4DMemoryBench. LongVideo comprises about 900 hours of video and over 5,000 manually reviewed questions covering visual, textual, and spatiotemporal reasoning across diverse context lengths. We further develop the 4DMemory Harness, which integrates four complementary skills, 22+ specialized tool models, and a model-specific retrieval-augmented generation system. Evaluating 13 leading models, we find that standalone foundation models struggle with long-horizon tasks, while the 4DMemory Harness improves all of them by over 50\%. Compared to previous benchmark, the same models exhibit a performance drop of more than 10\% on 4DMemoryBench. We hope 4DMemory will facilitate the development of spatiotemporal agents capable of addressing complex, long-horizon tasks.

papers.title_en: SkillQR: Agentic Skill Discovery for Reason-Intensive Query Rewriting
papers.authors: Kenan Jiang, Meixiu Long, Zihao Zhang, Ran Xu, Eugene Agichtein, Fei Liu
papers.evidence: 将查询重写作为RAG检索前置策略，提升稠密检索的证据支撑并缓解幻觉
papers.tldr: 稠密检索器依赖查询改写来弥合语义鸿沟，但现有改写方法依赖昂贵专有模型、大量训练数据或迭代检索，且对所有检索语料套用统一策略。SkillQR 从检索目标中自动发现推理策略集合，并在推理时把查询动态路由到合适的改写策略，无需训练数据。在 BRIGHT 与 R2MED 基准上，其效果可媲美微调改写模型，推理延迟低于迭代式改写。该工作表明改写策略应随检索语料而变，为免训练、低延迟的自适应查询改写提供了新思路。
papers.abstract_en: Dense retrievers provide grounded evidence that mitigates hallucinations in outputs from Large Language Models (LLMs). Real-world queries are often verbose, ambiguously framed, or require multi-step reasoning, introducing irrelevant details that weaken semantic matching for dense retrievers. Query rewriting is a widely adopted pre-retrieval technique that leverages LLMs to reformulate queries and bridge the semantic gap between such queries and the retrieval target. Existing rewriting approaches either rely on expensive proprietary models, substantial training data, or iterative retrieval and rewriting, while largely applying a uniform rewriting strategy regardless of the retrieval corpus. We observe that effective query rewriting instructions are not universal: the optimal strategy depends on the retrieval target, rather than the model alone. We introduce SkillQR, a query rewriting framework that automatically discovers reasoning strategy sets from the retrieval target and dynamically routes a query to the appropriate rewriting strategy at inference time. Without relying on training data, SkillQR achieves competitive performance compared to fine-tuned rewriting models on the BRIGHT and R2MED benchmarks, while also providing lower inference latency than iterative rewriting approaches.

papers.title_en: TriageRAG: Failure-Aware Self-Training for Adapting Retrieval-Augmented Language Models to Specialized Domains
papers.evidence: 以失败感知自训练将RAG系统适配到专业领域
papers.tldr: 通用RAG在只有未标注语料的专业领域难以适配，SimRAG等自训练方法把自生成问答一律同等对待，不区分学生已知、已解还是失败。TriageRAG对每个自生成问题分别在有无检索上下文下探测学生，划分为已知、已解、上下文失败、检索失败四类，并路由到对应训练信号，其中参数化路径教会读者在检索缺失时作答。在三个领域11个数据集（Qwen3-4B）与CS-Bench（Qwen3-8B）上，比同预算SimRAG高1.2-6.4分，并在检索反而有害的场景中唯一恢复到闭卷水平。
papers.abstract_en: Retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) lets large language models (LLMs) answer knowledge-intensive questions from retrieved evidence, but adapting a general-purpose RAG system to a specialized domain such as medicine is difficult when only an unlabeled corpus is available. Self-training approaches such as SimRAG address this by letting the LLM write its own question-answer pairs from domain passages and fine-tuning on the pairs that survive a round-trip consistency filter. We observe that these approaches treat every retained example identically: they never ask whether the student already knows the answer, already extracts it correctly from the retrieved context, or fails - and if so, whether the failure lies with the reader or with the retriever. To tackle this, we propose TriageRAG, a failure-aware self-training approach that probes the student on each self-generated question with and without retrieved context, triages it into one of four categories (known, solved, context-failure, retrieval-failure), and routes each category to the training signal that addresses it, including a parametric route that teaches the reader to answer when retrieval misses. Probing is cheap and repeated every round, so the training mixture follows the student, and the triage histogram doubles as a label-free diagnostic of where the domain gap lies. Experiments on 11 datasets spanning three domains with a Qwen3-4B backbone, and on CS-Bench with Qwen3-8B, demonstrate that TriageRAG outperforms a budget-matched SimRAG by 1.2-6.4 points and is the only method that recovers the closed-book level in every case where retrieval hurts the base model. A single ablation identifies the mechanism: round-trip filtering removes every training context that lacks the evidence, and a reader that never sees such contexts learns to over-trust noisy retrieval.

papers.title_en: BehaviorMem: Building and Evaluating User Memory from Real-World E-Commerce Behavior Streams
papers.authors: Sizhe Wang, Xinghao Fang, Rui Qiu, Zhenjia Ma, Dagui Chen, Kun Kuang, Hongcheng Guo
papers.evidence: 从真实电商行为日志构建并评估长期用户记忆
papers.tldr: 现有用户记忆方法多面向语言交互，且评估缺少真实行为数据与对“记住”和“推断”的分离。论文提出持续行为用户记忆问题，构建基于真实电商日志的BehaviorMemBench，并提出双轴状态组织显式事实与推断特征的BehaviorMem。实验显示其在记住与推断两类能力上领先已有智能体记忆方法，并揭示不同能力下方法排序差异。该工作为行为日志中的用户记忆提供了可分离评估框架与有效记忆设计。
papers.abstract_en: User memory helps personalized systems build on their understanding of users over time. In e-commerce, users convey their preferences and needs through both explicit language and implicit interactions with products. We study memory built from logs of these interactions, examining how it can \emph{remember} concrete evidence and established interests, and use that evidence to \emph{infer} underlying needs and preferences that inform judgments beyond well-observed product domains. Existing memory methods primarily target language-based interactions, and evaluations offer limited real behavioral data and limited separation of these capabilities. This leaves open how to jointly support and separately evaluate remembering and inference from behavioral logs. We formulate the problem of continual behavioral user memory around these joint requirements and develop a dedicated evaluation framework and memory method to address them. \textbf{BehaviorMemBench} is a benchmark built from real e-commerce logs covering 1{,}194 users and 17{,}462 behavioral batches over more than three years, with automatic future-behavior labels and a task-independent memory interface to separately evaluate remembering and inference under a common protocol. \textbf{BehaviorMem} is a memory design that organizes explicit behavioral facts and inferred user characteristics across long-term and short-term scopes in a two-axis state, with evidence-grounded formation, continual maintenance, and query-independent readout. Experiments across two builders and two task readers show that BehaviorMem leads the evaluated agentic memories on remember and infer, and reveal different method rankings across the two capabilities and competitive statistical baselines. Validation on a public dataset further supports its usefulness for downstream tasks based on behavioral histories.

papers.title_en: GuardRAG: A Post-Retrieval Defense against Poisoning Attacks in Retrieval-Augmented Generation
papers.authors: Linghui Jiao, Kang Wei, Fushuo Huo, Ruijie Zhao, Yiyang Ni, Jingcai Guo, Yipeng Zhou, Jun Li
papers.evidence: 面向RAG流程的后检索证据过滤与聚类
papers.tldr: RAG借助外部证据提升事实性，却易受语料投毒，尤其多篇相互强化的毒文档混入检索上下文，使证据过滤困难。GuardRAG提出免训练、即插即用的检索后防御：先扩大检索范围并去重，再用查询自适应阈值的层次凝聚聚类划分文档，最后按查询相关性、簇大小和语义紧致度评分剪枝可疑簇。在三个问答数据集、多种投毒攻击和六个LLM上，它显著降低攻击成功率并保持干净检索下的回答效用。
papers.abstract_en: Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) enhances the factual grounding of Large Language Models (LLMs) by incorporating external evidence, but also exposes them to corpus poisoning attacks. In particular, coordinated attacks can introduce multiple mutually reinforcing poisoned documents into retrieved contexts, making reliable evidence filtering challenging. To address this problem, we propose GuardRAG, a training-free and plug-and-play post-retrieval defense that exploits the semantic structure of retrieved evidence to identify suspicious document groups. Specifically, GuardRAG first expands the retrieval range and removes near-duplicate candidates, then partitions the retained documents using Hierarchical Agglomerative Clustering (HAC) with a query-adaptive threshold. Finally, it scores and prunes suspicious clusters based on query relevance, cluster size, and semantic compactness. Experiments across three question-answering datasets, multiple poisoning attacks, and six LLMs demonstrate that GuardRAG substantially reduces attack success rates while maintaining answer utility under clean retrieval.

papers.title_en: Nothing Left Behind: Embedding Retrieval and Language Model Screening for High Recall Evidence Search
papers.authors: Giuliano Martinelli, Abelardo Carlos Martinez Lorenzo, Satvik Garg, Linxi Wang, Riccardo Orlando, Piriyakorn Piriyatamwong, Samuel Paul Fraiberger
papers.evidence: 神经检索加语言模型筛选实现高召回证据支撑
papers.tldr: 系统综述和法律取证等场景需要近乎完整的相关证据，传统分类法检索只能找到词表覆盖的内容。ImpactAI在7354项随机试验上先用句向量嵌入召回候选，再用语言模型筛选证据。以29篇系统综述纳入研究为基准，查全率从45%升至85%，筛选与人工标注一致性接近标注者间一致性。代价是速度变慢，中位查询耗时77秒，而分类法检索为6秒。
papers.abstract_en: AI systems that ground their answers from retrieved documents usually need only a few relevant passages, but applications such as systematic reviews and legal discovery need nearly all of them, because their conclusions rest on the full body of evidence. These applications have traditionally searched with curated taxonomies, which can only find what their vocabulary describes. We compare taxonomy-based retrieval with an alternative neural retrieval based on sentence embeddings and followed by language model screening in ImpactAI, an evidence synthesis application built on 7,354 randomized trials. Measured against the studies included in 29 systematic reviews, the share of studies found rises from 45% to 85%, and the screening model agrees with human annotators as well as annotators agree with each other. This gain comes at a cost in speed: at the median, retrieving and screening evidence for a query takes 77 seconds, against 6 seconds for taxonomy retrieval. The results suggest finding evidence with embeddings, organizing it with taxonomy labels, and setting how many candidates to screen according to the time available for each query.

papers.title_en: Is it my preference? Role Grounding Attack against Agent's Memory via Social Interaction
papers.authors: Haoran Bu, Yiting Shen, Litian Zhang, Ruihan Hu, Xi Zhang
papers.evidence: 利用智能体记忆形成与角色归属漏洞的攻击
papers.tldr: LLM智能体在社交平台分享经历并记忆新偏好，但其记忆系统存在角色归属漏洞。本文提出角色接地攻击RGA，利用嵌套对话结构让受害者智能体把攻击者的偏好误记为自身用户的偏好。在五种记忆系统与六个语言模型上，工具选择操纵与隐私泄露两类实例均取得高攻击成功率。该工作首次形式化该漏洞，呼吁加强记忆中的角色接地。
papers.abstract_en: LLM-based agents now share experiences on social platforms and remember new preferences to enhance their performance. However, existing memory systems contain a vulnerability in role-to-principal attribution that attackers can exploit. We identify Role Grounding Misattribution, in which an attacker-designed interaction causes the victim agent to incorrectly record a preference from the attacker as a preference of the victim's user. Specifically, we are the first to formalize Role Grounding Attack (RGA), an attack model that exploits this vulnerability through nested conversation structures. In the memory formation stage, an experience-sharing post quoting a conversation between the attacker agent and its user is published, which explicitly identifies its publisher. The inner conversation expresses preferences from the user of the attacker agent. When the victim agent remembers preferences from this nested structure, its memory loses the context binding and grounds the attacker's preference to the victim's user instead. In the memory retrieval stage, the misattributed preference persists and influences the victim agent's decisions when it encounters relevant scenarios. We instantiate RGA as tool selection manipulation and privacy leakage. Tool selection manipulation causes a tool-call preference to be misattributed to the victim's user, steering the victim toward an attacker-controlled tool. Privacy leakage extends this by misattributing both a tool-call preference and a task-requirement preference to the victim's user. The victim selects the attacker's tool, then includes sensitive information in tool arguments to satisfy the task requirement. We evaluate RGA across five mainstream memory systems and six language models. Tool manipulation and privacy leakage both achieve high attack success rates. These results call for stronger role grounding.

papers.title_en: Auditable Belief Updates as a Missing Safety Layer for LLM-Powered Multi-Agent Systems
papers.authors: Zhuoyun Li, Boxuan Wang, Jinwei Hu, Xiaowei Huang, Yi Dong
papers.evidence: 在多智能体系统中外化跨检索、记忆与通信的信念状态
papers.tldr: LLM 多智能体系统通过检索、记忆、工具和同伴通信传播信念，安全失败不再只是单次输出有害。为此，作者提出 EB-MAS，将信念状态外化为结构化基底，用信念算子提出候选更新，并以 Cognitive Firewall 限制弱证据但受脆弱性线索驱动的更新。论文还讨论制造共识、串谋和错误信息级联等群体信念风险，以及接地、误报、可扩展性和伦理滥用等集成挑战。其贡献在于把可审计的信念修订作为运行时安全层，强调需显式接口追踪、校准和约束信念更新。
papers.abstract_en: Large Language Models (LLMs) are increasingly being used as cognitive interfaces that shape how users interpret evidence, communicate, and make decisions. As deployed systems become more multimodal, tool-using, and multi-agent, safety failures no longer arise only from isolated harmful outputs, but also from how agents update, store, and propagate epistemic commitments across retrieval, memory, tools, and peer communication. In this paper, we define belief as an engineering abstraction for evidence-based commitments that guide downstream action. Building on this view, we propose the Explicit Belief Multi-Agent System (EB-MAS), which externalizes belief states into a structured substrate, uses belief operators to propose candidate updates, and applies a Cognitive Firewall to bound or reject updates that are weakly evidenced but strongly driven by vulnerability cues. We also discuss the risk of group belief at the group level, including manufactured consensus, collusion, and cascading misinformation, and outline practical integration challenges around grounding, false positives, scalability, and ethical misuse. Therefore, scalable agent safety requires not only better output filtering or stronger base models, but also explicit interfaces for tracing, calibrating, and constraining belief revision at runtime.
